# Introduction

To use the WellnessLiving API, you’ll first need to be granted access to our servers and receive your login information. You can arrange this by contacting your WellnessLiving Account Executive.

Before getting started, you’ll need the following pieces of information:

- Your WellnessLiving username
- Your password
- Your business ID (BID)
- Your authorization code
- Your authorization ID

Once you’ve received this information, you can get started with installing the SDK and authentication.
